text:
Type: rustic trestle sofa table
Use: behind-sofa or entry display; living room, hallway, dining room
Style: rustic, farmhouse, industrial
Materials: distressed solid pine, saw-marked texture
Colors: dark weathered brown
Shape: thick plank top, chunky square legs, V-shaped diagonal braces, low stretcher, sturdy and heavy
Feel: earthy, rugged, warm
Goes with: linen, iron, leather, cream walls; farmhouse or rustic rooms
